Question 19
?

A=[−44−28−69−37421−85433],B=[00−2003−3−5241−4−110315]

Consider the matrices A and B above. By applying three matrix elementary column operations

  1. C1:=…
  2. C2:=C2+2C3
  3. C4:=…
each of the form Ci:=Ci+kC3, the matrix A can be transformed into the matrix B. What are the missing elementary column operations?

a
C1:=C1+2C3 and C4:=C4−4C3
b
C1:=C1−2C3 and C4:=C4−4C3
c
C1:=C1−4C3 and C4:=C4+2C3
d
C1:=C1+2C3 and C4:=C4+4C3
e
C1:=C1−2C3 and C4:=C4+4C3
Submit
